`create_model` computes `flat` and converts the snapshots stored in `n.model.parameters`, but leaves `sns` itself unchanged. It passes that original MultiIndex to the variable and constraint builders, including both transmission-loss constraint builders; the context manager only changes component-data access, not the passed snapshot index. Thus, with `"flat"` or `"auto"` under v1 semantics, the builder arguments do not have the required flat representation.
